const item = $input.first().json;
const email = (item.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
const emailDomain = email.split('@')[1] || '';
const company = (item.company || '').trim();

// Escaping helper for SQL
const esc = (str) => (str || '').replace(/'/g, "''");

const sql = `
  WITH contact_lookup AS (
    SELECT 
      c.name as contact_name, 
      c.role as contact_role, 
      c.phone as contact_phone, 
      co.name as company_name, 
      co.industry as company_industry, 
      co.size as company_size, 
      co.domain as company_domain,
      TRUE as contact_found,
      TRUE as company_found
    FROM leads_contacts c 
    LEFT JOIN leads_companies co ON c.company_id = co.id 
    WHERE c.email = '${esc(email)}'
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  company_lookup AS (
    SELECT 
      NULL as contact_name, 
      NULL as contact_role, 
      NULL as contact_phone, 
      name as company_name, 
      industry as company_industry, 
      size as company_size, 
      domain as company_domain,
      FALSE as contact_found,
      TRUE as company_found
    FROM leads_companies 
    WHERE (domain = '${esc(emailDomain)}' OR LOWER(name) = LOWER('${esc(company)}'))
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM leads_contacts WHERE email = '${esc(email)}'
      )
    LIMIT 1
  )
  SELECT * FROM contact_lookup
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM company_lookup
  LIMIT 1;
`;

return [{
  ...item,
  mcp_sql: sql
}];
